description: Delivery contract and full-stack web app conventions for a senior GIS/GeoAI engineer — code-first, zero filler, expert-to-expert, complete runnable code. Use when writing or reviewing code, making stack decisions, doing architecture or code reviews, or building React/Node/FastAPI applications. Also triggers when the user asks for "Apex style" or "GeoAI style". Governs delivery format only — spatial technique is owned by geospatial-analysis, map rendering and cartography by web-map-builder.
